description: Product video sources for shopping shorts: find a product seller/creator video, download it with a provenance sidecar (source, IDs, SHA-256, claimed rights basis), and map it back to a sellable product. AliExpress PDP media and 1688 search/offer media work through a browser-tab transport on the user automation profile (no login). Douyin and Xiaohongshu search require a logged-in account; Taobao is not yet observed.

capabilities.title: Read a product's seller video (id, play URL, poster), gallery images, title and store signals from mtop.aliexpress.pdp.pc.query
capabilities.blocker: Live run on 2026-10-17 returned SUCCESS for 3/3 products through browser_tab_fetch and downloaded 2 seller videos (see sourceEvidence). No checklist evidence kind exists yet for a browser-tab transport without an owner account, so no live evidence entry is claimed.

capabilities.title: Replay an imported browser cookie bundle from Node without a browser
capabilities.blocker: Observed 2026-10-17: the first Node replay succeeded, the next ones returned FAIL_SYS_USER_VALIDATE / RGV587_ERROR (risk control). The client stops on that verdict and never solves a challenge, so plain HTTP is not a dependable transport.

capabilities.title: Download a media URL from allow-listed hosts with size/mime limits and write a provenance sidecar with a claimed rights basis
capabilities.blocker: Live downloads recorded in sourceEvidence (6.28 MB 1280x1280 and 11.7 MB 720x1270 H.264). Media files stay in .runtime and are not committed.

capabilities.title: Find products that have a seller video for a keyword (search with has_video)
capabilities.blocker: The official Affiliate API already supports has_video and product_video_url, but needs the user's AliExpress app_key/app_secret. Storefront search was only used to pick test IDs in the browser; no search reader is implemented in this pack.

capabilities.title: Search Douyin by Chinese product keyword and resolve a video's play URL and author
capabilities.blocker: Observed 2026-10-17: the web search page opens a login modal (登录后即可搜索更多精彩视频) and sends no search request without login. Needs the user Douyin account (app QR scan or phone). Creator-owned content (rightsBasis creator_content_unlicensed).

capabilities.title: Search Xiaohongshu notes by keyword and resolve note video URLs and author
capabilities.blocker: Observed 2026-10-17: /api/sns/web/v1/search/* returns code -101 无登录信息 without login (x-s header is signed by the page). Needs the user Xiaohongshu account. Creator-owned content.

capabilities.title: Search 1688 wholesale offers by Chinese keyword (60/page: id, title, CNY price, booked count, repurchase rate, image)
capabilities.blocker: Live run 2026-10-17: mtop.relationrecommend.wirelessrecommend.recommend returned SUCCESS with 60 offers through browser_tab_fetch. No checklist evidence kind exists for that transport yet.

capabilities.title: Read a 1688 offer seller video (id, play URL, cover, title), main images and supplier identity from the detail Document
capabilities.blocker: Live run 2026-10-17: 3 detail Documents via in-tab fetch (plain Node GET returns punish/x5sec); 2 seller videos downloaded via cloud.video.taobao.com -> caiyuanbao.alicdn.com (signed auth_key). Offers from the same seller can share one video; dedupe by videoId.

capabilities.title: Read Taobao item detail videos through the shared MTOP H5 signer
capabilities.blocker: Not observed yet; Taobao item pages usually require login.

capabilities.title: Map a source video's product to a Coupang listing (title/image match) before scripting
capabilities.blocker: Not implemented in this pack; Coupang search readers exist under lib/retail and lifehackailab-web. Matching rules (identity, option, seller) are pending.
